authorization: Human explicitly restarts toward one reliable sitting cycle and one upright-lean cycle: Observe,position,contact,transfer weight,hold,stand again.
immediate_goal: Two sensor-driven complete cycles on compatible furniture, each independently repeated from3starts before scaling.
deferred: 100sitting+100leaning and PPO follow reliable cycles; no newPPO or automated queue now.

new_architecture.stage_progress: Measured tracking, qualified contact/load and stability; time only limits a stage, never asserts contact or stability.
new_architecture.surface_memory: Rigid measured map with explicit pose uncertainty and last visual verification; blind extrapolation never marked fresh.
new_architecture.motion: Valid feedback primitive perstage, not a time-indexed whole-motion prior. Exit from support is explicitly validated.
new_architecture.contact_trigger: Sensor-only estimator requires separate whole-start validation including unknown/failure states. Simulator contact is labels and evaluation only.
new_architecture.upright_lean_intent: Added posture qualification: both knees<=35deg during entire qualifying hold; no knee-lock or electrical-energy claim.
new_architecture.sit: Preserve existing legal pelvis/thigh support definition.
new_architecture.cycle_timing: Keep original first20s standing-to-rest trial, including its final5s support test. Append up to20s for unloading/standing; do not replace original rest test with standing success.
new_architecture.stand_again: After explicit unload/clearance, verify near-original standing pose and two continuous quiet seconds without furniture support, in addition to unchanged all-tick safety.
new_architecture.reward: First master safe contact/hold and stand-up. Later minimize holding-effort integral on complete successful cycles; no reward for failed prefixes.

first_work: Implement stage/memory/action/audit contracts and independently test them. Use saved armchair successes/failures only as contact-observer development fixtures; their83deg squat is not an upright lean success.
completion_is_not: Source tests, saved replay, source review, repeated teacher commands, partial starts or a process exit are not complete-cycle success.
